simple.summary: בִּכּוּרָה (bikkûwrâh) means the early fig First listed occurrence: Hos 9 10.

definitions.full: H1063. bikkurah בִּכּוּרָה noun feminine first ripe fig, early fig (regarded as a delicacy) (Löw 391 ; compare Arabic , Spanish albacora , Moorish bokkôre ) Micah 7:1 ; Hosea 9:10 ; suffix בִּכּוּרָהּ = בִּכּוּרָתָהּ (read בִּכּוּרָה Di), Isa 28:4 ; plural בַּכֻּרוֺת Jer 24:2 **probably a different word, plural abstract = early ripeness , compare Du.
